current_build_observations: The accepted Round Three APK was installed after the temporary emulator session was lost. Only the genuine historical banked main and pending progress files were restored and verified before launch. This is restoration, not retention across that host-session loss.

Ordinary beam aiming displayed never-completed guidance, completed currently-lit guidance with a teal outer ring, and completed off-beam guidance with an urgent coral outer ring while routing was retained.
Two ordinary free Foghorn uses consumed charges and displayed their wave effect. Optional ad buttons, purchases and daily claims were not used.

One guided boat was observed approaching the harbor and then arriving without further reaiming at the cone apex. No stall was observed for that boat; no exact speed constant or fully uncovered near-shore exception is inferred.
Android Back paused genuine watches. Pause held the same elapsed time through Android Home/background return and a further wait.

A natural failed watch with two rescued and two lost boats remained unbanked until Return to harbor. It then awarded the source-defined 6 coins / 8 XP once. The local watch10 achievement counted total watches; it did not unlock campaign mission10.

Home Back and cold launch retained the banked main bytes without another restoration; the later loaded Home was visually confirmed. Existing mission stars, owned upgrades/settings, unassisted record and perfect-watch count were retained.
A separate genuine watch supplied tablet action views. Explicit Leave this watch discarded its unfinished progress and left banked main bytes unchanged.

All 18 unmodified screenshots were independently reviewed at the actual phone and logical7/10-inch display profiles. Important controls and pause cards fit. Long workshop, briefing, coast and mission lists intentionally scroll.
Original display overrides were cleared and original radio flags restored; normal Launcher and actual connected-network state were checked. A fresh stopped full private backup was verified.
